svg.title: Where data goes
svg.desc: Inside your Mac, Slack messages reach your signed-in Slack tab, the Misha Browser extension, the native host and the Misha app, which gives them to the clone. The clone runs on Claude Code or OpenCode and sends its conversation to Anthropic, or to OpenAI or another provider set up in OpenCode, and reads the services you connect. An image the clone reads goes to a one-shot call that reaches Anthropic, or OpenAI or another provider. Workers started by the app talk to their model provider and to the services. The extension posts to Slack from your Slack tab. Your own agent sessions can use Browser control when it is on, or the standalone browser tools, and reach your other tabs, the sites they have open, and your screen, mouse and keyboard; workers you start there also need a profile that grants its tools. The shipped connector does not serve the Slack clone or workers it starts.
